title: Weekend Wine Down Ep 4 - Sara Learns A Lesson on Good Faith Deposits & Exclusivity
description: After years of deals, Sara changes her mind on the value a good faith deposit and exclusivity provision can bring to a deal in the letter of intent (LOI) phase. Spoiler alert, they're more valuable than she initially thought... Watch this episode for a rare sighting of a lawyer (gasp) admitting she changed her mind on something!
